name: Perfoliate Pepperwort
desc: Perfoliate Pepperwort (Lepidium perfoliatum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 13 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lepidium perfoliatum is a species of flowering plant in the mustard family known by the common names clasping pepperweed and perfoliate pepperwort.
